tools.wedding-checklist-generator.h2_tex: What a US wedding checklist actually covers
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.span_t: The two pages that dominate US search for this task — The Knot's 12-month planning countdown and Zola's ultimate checklist — use the same spine:
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.strong: 12+ months out, then one section per month, then 2 weeks / week before / day before / day of / after the wedding
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.span_t: . Both note that the average engagement is about 15 months, so the first block is research and vision, not bookings.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: Our generator follows that structure and adds the one thing a printed PDF cannot: a live progress bar and a saved state in your browser. Tick a task today, come back in three weeks, and it is still ticked. Copy or print the whole list when a planner or parent asks for it.

tools.wedding-checklist-generator.summar: How long before the wedding should I start planning?
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: The Knot's 2026 Real Weddings Study reports an average engagement of 15 months in the US. Twelve months is a comfortable planning window; a small wedding or elopement can be organised in 3–6 months. The checklist adapts to whatever date you enter, keeping the order of tasks intact.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.summar: When should wedding invitations be mailed?
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: US etiquette guidance puts formal invitations at 2–3 months before the wedding, and 4–6 months ahead for a destination wedding. Save-the-dates go out 6–8 months ahead locally and 10–12 months ahead for destination weddings.

tools.wedding-checklist-generator.summar: Can I print the checklist or share it with my planner?
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: Yes. Print / PDF produces a clean list without the tool controls, and Copy result gives you plain text you can paste into an email, a shared document, or a planning spreadsheet.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.summar: Does this work for a small wedding or elopement?
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: Yes. Choose Small wedding, Destination, or Elopement and the checklist is filtered to the tasks that still apply — you will not be chased about hotel blocks or a 200-person seating plan.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.summar: When should we write our vows?
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: Both The Knot and Zola place the first vow draft about two months out. Write a loose structure early, then refine it; 61% of US couples now write personal vows, and 150–250 words is the usual target length.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.h2_tex: Every box ticked? Keep the day.
tools.wedding-checklist-generator.p_text: The timeline ends, the venue empties, and the film is what you watch again. Turn your photos into a 60–90 second cinematic wedding film.
